message:
Walk canonical note order on arrow navigation — tie fragments collapse (#368) (#440)

selectAdjacentNote built its step list from raw MusicXML notes, so a canonical note split across a barline (hs-sn-000123, -2, -3) left indexOf pinned to the first fragment and ArrowRight could never advance past it. canonicalNoteOrder() dedupes in document order; chord members keep distinct canonicalIds, rests stay out.

Co-authored-by: Devin <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
